sql.query: UPDATE tbl_contract_document_clauses dc INNER JOIN tbl_generated_contracts gc ON gc.id=dc.contractId AND gc.tenantId=dc.tenantId SET dc.clauseHeading=:heading,dc.clauseTextSnapshot=:clauseText,dc.displayOrder=:displayOrder,dc.isIncluded=CASE WHEN dc.clauseBehaviour='mandatory' THEN 1 ELSE :isIncluded END,dc.modifiedByUserId=:userId,dc.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE dc.id=:id AND dc.contractId=:contractId AND dc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status='draft' AND NULLIF(TRIM(:heading2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:text2),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.drafts.edit' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=dc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
